title: Sales agent: follow Dataverse business skills for your sales processes
summary: Hold: the briefing treats sharing as a prerequisite for any seller to use a skill, although owners can use their own skills. It also promises that disabling the Enterprise Copilot Platform client affects only Sales agent, which the documentation does not establish. The roadmap details, documented control paths and two Dataverse update operations are supported.

claims.fix: Replace 'so nothing reaches sellers until a skill exists and is shared' with 'so a skill must exist, be active and be accessible to the seller before Sales agent can use it'. Owners can use their own skills; sharing is not a universal prerequisite. See https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-business-skills#test-and-troubleshoot-skill-use.

claims.quote: An administrator must assign users the Skill Sharing Role, either directly or through a team. Users must also have the security role that the skill is shared with.
